archive: All PNGs are individual YouTube storyboard cells at native cell resolution. No enlargement, repainting or change of contrast. The JPEG is an unmodified promotional still.

primaryReferences.observation: Konami promotional Arcade still archived by Silent Hill Memories. Dorsal surfaces and contrasting undersides in a swarm.

GameTrailers cabinet footage as uploaded by Grzesiek4Ever. Upper-left near-camera complete specimen outlines the underside and splayed jointed limbs. Cabinet perspective and overexposure limit texture interpretation.
Direct recording by MegaYoYo. First Brookhaven boss. Several dorsal shells in the foreground, outer specimens partly overlap.
Direct recording by MegaYoYo. First Brookhaven boss. Small separated airborne or screen-facing examples at different angles, with other insects near the frame edges.

corroboration.note: Firsthand cabinet play account describes bugs covering the floor and leaping onto the screen during the first Pyramid Head encounter.
Species identification of the Brookhaven swarm and the insects emitted by Mama. Secondary reference only.

limits: The photographs document whole individuals in ventral and oblique views and dorsal surface detail on overlapping individuals. A strictly lateral idle and fine surface details are reconstructed. No measured attack animation, full turnaround, rig or 1:1 certification.
